Voice to Video AI — Initial Release

- Convert uploaded voice recordings (MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG up to 200MB) into AI-generated 1080p MP4 videos with matching visuals and captions.
- Fully automated setup: fetches free authentication token and connects to cloud GPU backend on first use.
- Supports quick export, download, preview, and iterative refinement of videos.
- Built-in error handling for unsupported files, expired tokens, rate limits, and export issues.
- Easy balance and status checks; works out-of-the-box for fast content creation without manual video editing.
